name: hk_mt_mongkok_profile
requirements: Mong Kok 5-table profile: mean NO2, rush congestion of <=500m segments, #schools <=500m, dominant land_use <=500m. Store mk_no2 (float,1dp), mk_rush_ci (float,2dp), mk_schools (int), mk_dom_landuse (str).

turns.query: Build an integrated roadside profile for Mong Kok air-quality station (station_id 14) over June 2025 (2025-06-01 to 2025-06-30). Report: (1) its mean NO2 (non-NULL hourly, 1 dp); (2) the mean traffic congestion_index during rush hours 08 and 09 across the road segments whose geometry lies within 500 metres of the station (non-NULL, 2 dp); (3) the number of 'EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION' sensitive areas whose polygon centroid is within 500 metres of the station; (4) the land_use_zone land_category with the largest total intersection area with the 500-metre buffer around the station.
